featured.desc: Full-stack platform that automates the entire operation — from order to delivery. WhatsApp ordering with AI (Gemini), real-time kitchen, automatic PIX payment, and full delivery tracking with live driver location for the customer.

PIX payment with automatic QR Code generation
Delivery with zones and live tracking
Cashback system, coupons and loyalty program
Admin dashboard with metrics and reports
Customer management, addresses and order history

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Back-end developer with expertise in Java, Python, and C#. I deliver complete solutions — from database to interface — focused on quality and results.
about.whoP1: I'm a developer focused on back-end, working with Java / Spring Boot, C# / .NET, and Python to create robust, secure, and well-documented REST APIs. I apply Clean Architecture, JWT authentication, and design patterns that ensure maintainability and scalability.
about.whoP2: Although my strength is back-end, I also deliver professional front-end with React and TypeScript — this portfolio you're viewing is a real example of my full-stack work.
about.whoP3: I work with process automation using n8n and Python, creating smart workflows with webhooks that connect systems and eliminate manual tasks. I also manage PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MySQL databases.
about.exp1Desc: Architecture and development of APIs in Java/Spring Boot and C#/.NET with JWT auth, versioning, Swagger docs, and relational database integration.
about.exp2Desc: SPAs with React and TypeScript — reusable components, smooth animations, responsive design, and back-end API integration.
about.exp3Desc: Automated workflows with n8n and Python — webhooks, data processing, notifications, and external system connections.
about.exp4Desc: Modeling and optimization of PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MySQL databases. Docker containerization and Git versioning.
about.approach1Desc: I write readable, testable, and organized code. SOLID, Clean Code, and design patterns aren't theory — they're part of my daily practice.
about.approach2Desc: Focused on delivering what works in production. Documented APIs, robust error handling, and code ready to scale.
about.approach3Desc: I keep clients updated at every stage. I align expectations, propose solutions, and deliver on the agreed timeline.
